## Idea Zoo Contribution PR

### What is changed?
- [ ] New idea
- [ ] Idea update
- [ ] UX/content update
- [ ] Bug fix

### Idea metadata (required for idea PR)
- Research Area:
- Difficulty:
- Compute Requirement:
- Source (AI-generated / Community / Hybrid):

### Checklist
- [ ] I used `ideas/TEMPLATE.md` as baseline
- [ ] I explained challenge, method, expected outcome, and why now
- [ ] I considered feasibility for open-source researchers
- [ ] I agree this can be discussed publicly in Idea Zoo
